description: The console is a REMOTE page served by the gateway on loopback, loaded into the main window's webview. It needs shell open so 'open in browser' buttons can reach the system browser — the webview's own target="_blank" handling is swallowed by wry — and native clipboard write so copy buttons never hit the engine's clipboard permission prompt or its not-focused rejection. The origin is pinned to loopback HTTP on ANY port because the gateway is not always on 4000: an environment switch hands over to the target env's own config.yaml port and the shell follows it (see watch_gateway). Only the `main` window is in scope, so no IPC command is exposed to any other document that window may navigate to.
